core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: At levels 10-14, hit dice increase by the printed fixed values; hit point modifiers from Constitution are ignored for the starred values.

weapons.rule: May use any weapon without limitation.

fighting_styles.rule: May fight with a weapon two-handed.
May fight with a weapon in each hand.
May fight with a weapon and shield.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throws and saving throws advance as fighter progression.
Successful missile and melee attacks gain the damage bonus shown in level_progression.

rules.rule: When wearing leather armor or lighter garb, the assassin may move silently as a thief of the same level.
When wearing leather armor or lighter garb, the assassin may hide in shadows as a thief of the same level.
When wearing leather armor or lighter garb, the assassin may backstab as a thief of the same level.
If wearing armor heavier than leather, these abilities are not available.

skill.name: move_silently
skill.rule: Uses thief move silently ability at same level while wearing leather armor or lighter garb.

skill.name: hide_in_shadows
skill.rule: Uses thief hide in shadows ability at same level while wearing leather armor or lighter garb.

skill.name: backstab
skill.rule: Uses thief backstab ability at same level while wearing leather armor or lighter garb.
Backstab multiplier uses the value shown in level_progression.

rules.rule: Upon reaching 9th level, the assassin may construct a hideout.

outcomes.outcome: Gain 2d6 1st level assassin apprentices who come to learn under a master.
If hired, apprentices must be paid standard rates for ruffians.
These thugs serve with some loyalty.
At least one apprentice is an infiltrator working for local rivals.

acquisition_rules.rule: May construct a hideout at 9th level.

cost_rules.rule: If hired, apprentices must be paid standard rates for ruffians.

loyalty_or_morale_rules.rule: These thugs serve with some loyalty.
At least one apprentice is an infiltrator sent by local rivals.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: At levels 10-14, hit dice use the printed fixed values shown in level_progression.

weapons.rule: May fight with any missile weapons.
May fight with any one-handed melee weapons.

fighting_styles.rule: May wield a weapon in each hand.

restrictions.restriction: Cannot wear armor heavier than leather.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throws and saving throws advance as thief progression.

custom_subsystem.name: performance
custom_subsystem.definition: Skilled performance using song, poetry, or instruments.

rules.rule: The bard chooses one type of performance known at 1st level.
The Perform proficiency may be taken to learn other types of performances.

custom_subsystem.name: bardic_knowledge
custom_subsystem.definition: Knowledge-based class subsystem consisting of loremastery and arcane dabbling.

rules.rule: Loremastery allows deciphering occult runes, remembering ancient history, identifying historic artifacts, and similar tasks.
Arcane dabbling allows attempts to use wands, staffs, and other magic items usable only by mages.
A failed arcane dabbling attempt backfires in some desultory way at Judge's discretion.
Arcane dabbling throw reduces by 2 per level to a minimum of 3+.
Loremastery throw reduces by 1 per level.

ability.name: inspire_courage
ability.summary: May inspire courage through performance before battle.

procedure.step: Recite heroic lays or epic poems for one round before a battle.

rules.rule: Targets allies within a 50' radius.
Cannot inspire courage on characters already engaged in combat.

limits.limit: Any given character can be inspired once per day per class level.

outcomes.outcome: Allies gain +1 to attack throws.
Allies gain +1 to damage rolls.
Allied monsters or NPCs gain +1 to morale rolls.
Allies gain +1 to saving throws against magical fear.

ability.name: read_languages
ability.summary: May read languages, including ciphers, treasure maps, and dead languages, but not magical writings.

rules.rule: Requires a proficiency throw of 5+ on 1d20.
If the throw fails, the bard may not try to read that particular piece of writing again until reaching a higher experience level.

ability.name: hireling_inspiration
ability.summary: Chronicles of battle improve morale of hired followers.

rules.rule: Any henchmen and mercenaries hired by the bard gain +1 morale if the bard is present to witness and record their deeds.
This bonus stacks with modifiers from Charisma or proficiencies.

ability.name: hall
ability.summary: May build a hall and become a ruler.

outcomes.outcome: Up to 1d4+1x10 0th level mercenaries come to apply for jobs and training.
1d6 bards of 1st-3rd level come to apply for jobs and training.
If hired, they must be paid standard rates for mercenaries.

ability.name: arcane_scroll_use
ability.summary: May read and cast magic from arcane scrolls.

rules.rule: Requires a proficiency throw of 3+ on 1d20.

outcomes.outcome: On success, the bard reads and casts the arcane scroll.
On failure, the spell does not function as expected and may create a horrible effect at Judge's discretion.

acquisition_rules.rule: May build a hall and become a ruler at 9th level.

cost_rules.rule: If hired, they must be paid standard rates for mercenaries.

entry_restrictions.restriction: Dedicated to the service of a goddess of war.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: At levels 10-14, hit dice increase by the printed fixed values; hit point modifiers from Constitution are ignored for the starred values.

weapons.rule: May only use piercing and slashing melee weapons.
Examples given include daggers, swords, spears, and polearms.

fighting_styles.rule: May wield a weapon in each hand.
May fight with a two-handed weapon.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throws and saving throws advance as cleric progression.
Gain +1 bonus to initiative if able to move freely.
Gain Armor Class bonus shown in level_progression if able to move freely.

access_rules.rule: May cast divine spells starting at 2nd level.
Uses the same spell progression as clerics.
Uses the same rules for learning and casting spells as clerics.
Spell list differs from the cleric list.
Must uphold the doctrines of her faith and god and suffers penalties if they are violated.

ritual_access.rule: At 11th level, may learn and cast ritual divine spells of 6th and 7th level.

rules.rule: May turn undead like a cleric.

ability.name: mobile_defense
ability.summary: Free movement improves initiative and Armor Class.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to initiative if able to move freely.
Gain +1 bonus to Armor Class if able to move freely.
Armor Class bonus becomes +2 at 7th level.
Armor Class bonus becomes +3 at 13th level.

ability.name: spell_research_and_minor_item_creation
ability.summary: May research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions.

ability.name: greater_item_creation
ability.summary: May create more powerful magic items.

rules.rule: May create weapons, rings, and staffs.

ability.name: rituals_and_construct_creation
ability.summary: May use powerful divine rituals and create magical constructs.

rules.rule: May learn and cast ritual divine spells of 6th and 7th level.
May craft magical constructs such as golems and animated statues.

ability.name: chaotic_necromancy_and_undeath
ability.summary: Chaotic bladedancers gain additional dark creation options.

rules.rule: May create necromantic servants.
May become undead herself.

ability.name: temple
ability.summary: May construct a temple as a stronghold.

rules.rule: If she has not lost the favor of her deity, the cost of building the temple is half the normal amount due to miraculous assistance from her deity.

outcomes.outcome: Once the temple is completed, fanatically loyal bladedancers called the faithful come to defend the Blade-Mistress.

acquisition_rules.rule: May construct a temple as a stronghold at 9th level.

cost_rules.rule: If the bladedancer has not lost the favor of her deity, the cost of building the temple is half the normal amount due to miraculous assistance from her deity.
Followers in service must be provided food and lodging.
Followers in service need not be paid wages.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: At levels 10-14, hit dice use the printed fixed values shown in level_progression.

weapons.rule: May use any one-handed melee weapons.

fighting_styles.rule: May fight with a weapon and shield.
May wield a weapon in each hand.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throws and saving throws advance as fighter progression.
Gain +1 bonus to all attack throws with missile weapons.
Successful missile and melee attacks gain the damage bonus shown in level_progression.

ability.name: animal_reflexes
ability.summary: Quick reactions in combat and surprise situations.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to initiative.
Gain +1 bonus to surprise rolls.

ability.name: difficult_to_spot
ability.summary: Can evade detection through cover and terrain.

rules.rule: Outdoors, may disappear into woods and underbrush with a proficiency throw of 3+ on 1d20.
In dungeons, if motionless and quiet in cover, may escape detection with a proficiency throw of 14+ on 1d20.

ability.name: wilderness_guide
ability.summary: Guided parties gain bonuses on wilderness procedures.

rules.rule: When the party is in country familiar to the explorer, the party gains +4 to proficiency throws to avoid getting lost.
In any terrain except clear and grassland terrain, the party gains +5 to proficiency throws to evade wilderness encounters.
The party may evade wilderness encounters even when surprised on a proficiency throw of 19+.

ability.name: hireling_confidence
ability.summary: Hirelings on wilderness expeditions gain morale.

rules.rule: Hirelings on a wilderness adventure led by the explorer gain +1 to morale.
This bonus stacks with modifiers from Charisma or proficiencies.

ability.name: border_fort
ability.summary: May build a border fort in the borderlands or wilderness.

outcomes.outcome: Up to 1d4+1x10 0th level mercenaries come to apply for jobs and training.
1d6 explorers of 1st-3rd level come to apply for jobs and training.
If hired, they must be paid standard rates for mercenaries.
The explorer becomes warden of nearby settlers.
More settlers are attracted over time.
Nearby settlers look to the Warden as leader responsible for the growth and safety of their settlement.

acquisition_rules.rule: May build a border fort in the borderlands or wilderness at 9th level.

cost_rules.rule: If hired, followers must be paid standard rates for mercenaries.

loyalty_or_morale_rules.rule: The Warden becomes the leader of nearby settlers and is responsible for their growth and safety.
